sources.title: Introducing GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark
sources.evidence: February 12, 2026 research-preview announcement: smaller GPT-5.3-Codex variant, text-only, 128K context, interactive coding, Cerebras serving, Pro access and select API design partners. Agentic benchmark timing includes tool execution. No numerical model size or model architecture is disclosed. Indexed article text was accessed; direct HTML returned 403 and the browser stayed on a challenge, so original chart labels could not be inspected.

sources.title: Introducing OpenAI GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark Powered by Cerebras
sources.evidence: Hardware partner independently dates Spark preview to February 12, 2026 and identifies OpenAI as its developer. Describes focused edits, planning and agentic coding. Trillion-parameter capacity refers to Cerebras infrastructure and future frontier models, not Spark size.

sources.title: Codex changelog: Spark launch and retirement
sources.evidence: Full changelog downloaded and searched for exact Spark references. February 12 launch entry specifies text-only 128K; September 14, 2026 entry retires the research preview from the desktop app, CLI and IDE extension. No intervening Spark capability expansion was found in these entries. Public API access was unavailable at launch; private design-partner access in the announcement is a different scope.

sources.title: Models: deprecated Codex models
sources.evidence: Current model guide confirms Spark retired September 14, 2026 from Codex product surfaces. General reasoning controls describe available models; this does not independently establish retired Spark reasoning support.

sources.title: OpenAI Models at Ultrafast Speed
sources.evidence: Later partnership comparison explicitly names GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark alongside GPT-5.6 Sol Ultrafast. Reports Spark deployment and throughput but no Spark parameter count, activated parameter count, or neural architecture. Its historical preview language is superseded for availability by OpenAI retirement documentation.

sources.title: Speeding up agentic workflows with WebSockets in the Responses API
sources.evidence: April 22, 2026 engineering account identifies Spark as a production user of the Codex Responses API tool-execution loop and WebSocket mode. Caching discussed here is API response state, tokenization and routing; it does not establish Spark Transformer attention, KV caching or parameter counts.

sources.title: All models
sources.evidence: Current API catalog separately identifies gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b as Apache-licensed open-weight models. Spark is absent and no Spark weights or technical specifications are supplied.

sources.title: OpenAI Services Agreement
sources.evidence: Sections 2.2 and 9.1 grant limited hosted-service access and reserve service intellectual-property rights. Supports descriptive proprietary classification for hosted Spark, not a downloadable weight license.

sources.title: Attempted exact Spark API model documentation
sources.evidence: Direct request returned HTTP 404 on review. No current exact API model card or endpoint operation was verified.

sources.title: Stop Shipping AI Slop: How Codex Spark Changes The Way You Code
sources.evidence: March 4, 2026 Spark-specific usage guide confirms its 128K window and tool-based workflows including edits, tests and review. It does not provide parameter counts, neural architecture, or an exact-model reasoning-effort specification.

name.note: Use the developer’s exact model name.

developer.note: Cerebras supplies inference hardware; OpenAI develops the model.

family.note: Normalize the generation; Spark is a smaller GPT-5.3-Codex variant.

release_date.note: Earliest announced public research preview. February 5 belongs to full GPT-5.3-Codex.

open_weights.note: Hosted proprietary release; no Spark weight distribution identified.

license.note: Descriptive model-access classification, not an SPDX weight license.

parameters_b.note: Original announcements, later exact-model partner comparison and usage guide disclose no count. Searches for exact-model later technical/model-card and training research found no disclosure. Smaller, throughput and wafer memory are not parameter counts.

active_parameters_b.note: No Spark activated-weight definition or count found in these primary sources or exact-name later disclosure searches. Neither dense/MoE structure nor total-to-active equivalence is established.

architecture.note: Consulted original and later primary materials disclose serving hardware and API architecture, not the neural architecture. Exact-name training/interpretability searches found no model-structure disclosure. WebSocket state caching is not sufficient Transformer evidence.

context_window.note: 128K in the launch and March usage guide; last documented limit located before retirement, not a live endpoint test.

modalities.note: Text-only specification; no later documented multimodal expansion found. Clear unsupported image/PDF inputs.

reasoning.note: Exact-model reasoning capability could not be verified from accessible primary text. A secondary chart description identifies Spark reasoning efforts, but the original chart labels were inaccessible (direct HTML 403; browser challenge). Generic Codex controls and sibling capabilities are insufficient. Clear the flag to null pending primary chart verification; null does not mean no reasoning.

tool_call.note: Spark is documented in the Codex tool-execution loop, including edits and tests; no claim about every standalone API tool.

description.value: Low-latency GPT-5.3 coding model for interactive edits in Codex.
description.note: Scoped to the explicitly described use.

patch.notes: Research preview released February 12, 2026; retired from Codex desktop, CLI and IDE on September 14, 2026. Last documented specifications found are text-only and 128K context. Parameters and neural architecture remain undisclosed in the consulted primary materials. Dedicated reasoning support remains unverified; this does not establish absence of reasoning. Exact API model documentation returned 404. Private design-partner API access at launch does not establish general API availability.

summary: Correct Spark launch to February 12, 2026, normalize name/family, remove unsupported image/PDF inputs and clear unverified reasoning flag. Confirm 128K and tool use; record retirement. Model counts and architecture remain undisclosed after original and later primary-source checks.
